value.rationale: The singular disk-to-oval endpoint transition changes the long-chord probability exponent and is a natural, shape-stable stereological question. The theorem identifies the exact entire crossover curve from arbitrary support harmonics, proves that all odd perturbations are invisible at first order, and computes a sharp inverse-square-root far-crossover coefficient from the curvatures of the width maxima. The result is not a numerical benchmark or a single arbitrary slice.
